entries.title: Long PDFs use one article per 50 pages
entries.body: A PDF you add in full now counts as one article of your allowance for every 50 pages, rounded up, rather than one however long it is; articles you have already added are not recharged. If a PDF will not fit in what you have left, the app stops before any AI work and says why; otherwise it tells you how many it used. Switching on High-powered AI for such an article charges the same number again, or half as much while it is shared publicly.

entries.title: Opening a private link is recorded
entries.body: When you open somebody's private link to an article, the app records it: your account, how many times, and when you first and last opened it if you are signed in, or a rough count with first and last times if you are not. Only Spideryarn's administrators can see these records; the article's owner is not shown who opened it. The privacy policy and the sharing help page say so.

entries.title: The reading guide can get a mode ready
entries.body: Under an answer, the reading guide in Chat can offer to get Summary, Glossary, Quotes, Ideas, Skim or the quiz ready in the background, and shows when it has started and when it is ready. When it is confident from what you typed that you want one, it may start it itself, once per conversation.

entries.title: Chat knows roughly how much you have read
entries.body: On your own articles, Chat, Learn and the reading guide are told roughly how much of the article you have read, though not which parts, so answers can be pitched to where you have got to. They also no longer assume you know the article's field unless you have shown it. The privacy policy says so.

entries.title: Larger text and buttons on touch screens
entries.body: On phones, tablets and touch-screen laptops, much of the smallest interface text is at least 13 pixels, and Chat's buttons, source links, filter chips and footnote markers are larger to tap. A few labels in Diagram, Sketch and Illustrated stay smaller. Nothing changes on a computer without a touch screen.

entries.title: Sharing suggestions count a PDF's full size
entries.body: When an article will not fit in your allowance, the suggestion of articles to share publicly to make room now counts its full size, lists first those that free the most, and appears only if sharing them would be enough. Rebuilding an article from a longer PDF that needs more allowance stops and suggests adding it as a new article.

entries.title: Investigate reopens your latest question
entries.body: Going back to the Investigate view in Sources showed an empty box for a new question, even when you had already asked one there. It now reopens your newest conversation beside it, without sending anything, and coming back from a chat keeps that chat open. Your own questions are listed above the suggested ones.
